home: The road itself—feels wrong when stationary more than two days
appearance: Imazuran woman, late 40s, olive skin weathered by road dust, sharp brown eyes that count everything, ochre and grey traveling robes, silver measuring-chain belt, ink-stained hands
and_yet: Keeps Isarna shrine in lead wagon, burns expensive incense at every crossroads
wants: Profitable predictable routes, respect from both cultures, vengeance on lizard-men
does_not_want: Questions about husband's death, choosing factional sides, lizard-men mentioned as allies
oddly_also: Collects obscure road songs in journal, refuses water drawn south of the road
family: Late husband Irven (Elunad, killed by lizard-men 8yr ago), son Khalid (24, leads return caravans), daughter Sarit (22, manages Orziben warehouses), son Davin (19, Ilmenor scribe apprentice), brother Azghar (teamster)
self_image: Bridge between Gallaecian and Imazuran, keeper of husband's legacy, protector of her caravan family
recreation: Singing road songs at crossroads, updating ledgers by candlelight, polishing husband's waystone marker
dreams: Davin becomes respected Ilmenor scholar, safe profitable routes forever, finding who killed Irven
anecdotes: Once outbid a hobgoblin warlord for iron nails using only dried figs and honey
Navigated through fey-glamoured woods by singing Isarna hymns until dawn
Refused Covenant-Bound 'special cargo' offer despite massive payment
tragedies: Husband Irven killed in southern swamps 8 years ago (believes lizard-men responsible)
Has hidden map of 'safe paths' Irven drew before death—guards it obsessively
Receives coded letters from Davin hinting at dangerous Ilmenor secrets
pc_leverage: Prove lizard-men didn't kill Irven OR find actual killers; protect Davin; share intelligence on humanoid coordination; respect her authority on the road

caravan.route: Caelrun to Tagmira (primary), broader Luric Marches circuit
caravan.current_leg: Caelrun to Tagmira — party traveling with her
caravan.brother_azghar: Teamster, Taziri's brother, manages the wagons day-to-day
caravan.waystone_observance: Will stop at Waystone of Isarna west of Tagmira for offering (bread, silver thread)
caravan.dm_notes: Taziri is the party's most reliable civilian connection across the Luric Marches. She knows both Caelrun and Tagmira well and can brief the party on surface-level politics of either. She has no knowledge of the undead alliance. Her Isarna observance at the waystone is a natural scene transition into Tagmira.
